t: This is Matheson Lang Gardens, a council estate in North Lambeth. It takes its name from Matheson Lang, a Canadian-born actor and playwright, best remembered for his performances in Shakespeare plays in Britain. The estate is also remembered for a sadder reason. Arsema Dawit, a girl who lived here, died here in 2008, at the age of sixteen, the victim of a murder. It's a place with a theatrical name and a painful local memory.
